title: 第309章 又是汤第308章 超重
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: “别松太深。”
伊莲娜在花圃边上站定，“根浅，松多了会伤到。”
艾洛诺儿抬起头，冲她笑了一下，“知道啦。”
伊莲娜在旁边的石凳上坐下，手杖立在膝盖边上。
她看着艾洛诺儿的动作，没再说话。
风吹过来，带着泥土和花香的味道。
伊莲娜闭上眼睛，深吸了一口气。
晚饭的时候，桌上摆的不是烤肉，而是一大锅浓汤。
赛娜坐在椅子上，看着碗里软烂的食材，皱了皱眉。
“怎么又是汤？”
“你昨天吃肉咬不动。”
苏璃坐在她旁边，用木勺舀了一勺汤吹凉，递到她嘴边，“张嘴。”
赛娜看了他一眼，没动。
“怎么，还害羞？”
苏璃挑了挑眉，“你小时候让我喂饭的时候可不是这个态度。”
“我那时候才几岁！”
赛娜脸一红，“现在都一百多了……”
“一百多也得吃饭。”
苏璃把勺子往前送了送，“张嘴。”
赛娜抿了抿嘴唇，最后还是张开了嘴。
汤的温度刚刚好，味道也调得很淡，不咸不腻。
苏璃一勺一勺地喂，动作很慢，每一勺都吹得很仔细。
伊莲娜坐在对面，手里拿着一串葡萄。
她把葡萄皮剥干净，把果肉放进赛娜碗里。
“吃点水果。”
赛娜看了看碗里那颗剥得干干净净的葡萄，又看了看伊莲娜那张板着的脸。
伊莲娜哼了一声，继续剥下一颗。
艾洛诺儿坐在旁边，托着腮看这一幕，眼睛弯成了月牙。
晚饭吃到一半的时候，外面传来马蹄声。
苏璃放下勺子，走到门口看了一眼。
是王都的信使。
他接过信件，拆开扫了两眼。
“小石头寄来的。”
苏璃折好信纸，回到桌边，“他在极北之地建了个小城镇，问咱们要不要过去住。”
赛娜的手抖了一下。
“他……还好吗？”
“挺好。”
苏璃把信递给她，“你自己看。”
赛娜接过信，眼睛贴得很近才能看清上面的字。
她看了很久。
“回信。”
赛娜把信放下，“告诉他多穿衣服，少喝酒。
极北那地方冷，别仗着年轻就不当回事。”

"Don't loosen it too far."
Elena stood at the edge of the flower bed, "The roots are shallow and too loose will hurt them."
Elonelle raised her head and smiled at her, "I know."
Elena sat down on the stone bench next to her, with her cane standing next to her knees.
She looked at Elonelle's movements and said nothing.
The wind blew over, carrying the smell of earth and flowers.
Elena closed her eyes and took a deep breath.
…
At dinner time, instead of barbecue, there was a large pot of soup on the table.
Senna sat on the chair, looked at the soft ingredients in the bowl, and frowned.
"Why is it soup again?"
"You couldn't bite the meat yesterday."
Su Li sat next to her, took a spoonful of soup with a wooden spoon, blew it to cool, and handed it to her mouth, "Open your mouth."
Senna glanced at him and didn't move.
"Why, are you still shy?"
Su Li raised her eyebrows, "You didn't have this attitude when you asked me to feed you when you were a child."
"How old was I then!"
Senna blushed, "It's over a hundred now..."
"You have to eat even if you are over a hundred people."
Su Li moved the spoon forward and said, "Open your mouth."
Senna pursed her lips and finally opened her mouth.
The temperature of the soup is just right and the taste is very light, not salty or greasy.
Su Li fed her spoonful after spoonful, moving very slowly and blowing each spoonful carefully.
Elena sat opposite, holding a bunch of grapes.
She peeled the skins off the grapes and put the pulp into the Senna bowl.
"Eat some fruit."
Senna looked at the cleanly peeled grape in the bowl, and then at Elena's stern face.
"…Thank you."
Elena snorted and continued to peel off one.
Elonelle sat next to him, holding her chin up and watching this scene, her eyes curled into crescent moons.
Halfway through dinner, the sound of horse hooves was heard outside.
Su Li put down the spoon and walked to the door to take a look.
He is the messenger from the royal capital.
He took the letter, opened it and glanced at it.
"Sent from Xiao Shitou."
Su Li folded the letter and returned to the table, "He built a small town in the far north and asked us if we wanted to live there."
Senna's hands shook.
"Is he... okay?"
"Very good."
Su Li handed the letter to her, "Read it yourself."
Senna took the letter and put her eyes close enough to see the words on it.
She looked at it for a long time.
"Reply."
Senna put the letter down and said, “Tell him to wear more clothes and drink less.
It’s cold in the far north, so don’t take it lightly just because you’re young. "
